# Wood World Decor LLC

> Wood World Decor LLC is a Dubai-based interior design, joinery and fit-out company providing custom joinery, furniture, turnkey interior solutions, renovation, upholstery, wall cladding, painting and polishing, sculpture fabrication, and metal fabrication services.

## Company

Wood World Decor LLC is based in Al Quoz Industrial Area 1, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

The company provides interior and construction-related solutions for residential, commercial, hospitality and other interior projects, including custom joinery, furniture, fit-out and fabrication services.

Official Website: https://wwduae.com/

## Main Services

- Custom Joinery
- Interior Fit-Out
- Interior Design
- Custom Furniture
- Turnkey Interior Solutions
- Renovation
- Upholstery
- Wall Cladding
- Painting and Polishing
- Sculpture Fabrication
- Metal Fabrication
